title: 第1章办案，两个文件袋（新书发布求追读）
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

蓝星，新纪元29年。

第十三区。

夜色下的青川市是昏暗的。

因为电量限时供应。

市民只有每天早上十点到中午十二点、下午五点到晚上七点这四个小时才可以用电。

所以晚上七点后除了政府机关以及拥有发电机的富人区和某些娱乐场所外，大多数区域只有蜡烛与油灯。

各种肤色的技术性工作者或衣衫暴露、或干脆赤裸着，置身于黑暗中的屋檐下搔首弄姿揽客。

在灯光不够亮的情况下，身材好就格外有商业竞争力。

纵横交错毫无规划的街道、低矮的平房、简易的窝棚、随处堆积着的垃圾、翻找食物的野狗……

整座城市就像个大型贫民窟。

西城区，白云街105号。

这是一处二层小楼。

外墙用白色涂料粉刷，透过装有铁栅栏的窗户隐约可见里面橘黄色的灯光，与周围低矮简陋、烛火昏暗的住宅群显得格格不入。

一辆灰扑扑的黑色轿车在小楼前停下，三个男人先后下车。

为首一人约二十出头，身材高大壮硕，浓眉大眼英气逼人，黑色西服敞开着露出内里的白衬衣。

另外两人，胖的二十多岁，瘦的三十来岁，都穿黑色警察制服，一个警衔是警员、另一个是中级警员。

胖子手里提着一个印有十三区警徽并写着“青川市警察局”的手提箱。

瘦子深吸口气后抬手敲门。

“咚咚咚！”

“大晚上的谁啊？”屋里传出一道暴躁且不耐烦又有些警惕的喝问。

“警察！开门！”

屋内陷入短暂的安静。

片刻后门上

一个穿着褐色西服、个头中等、微胖、光头、留着两撇小胡子的中年男人通过窗口朝外面张望打量。

待看清三人的着装后，他眼中的警惕与烦躁退却了些。

“三位警官瞧着有些眼生啊？”

光头试探性的笑着说了一句。

“去你妈的！青川警察局几千号人你都认识吗？少他妈唧唧歪歪浪费时间，要不开门，要不就开席！”

西装革履的许景川冷脸将警官证隔着窗口展示了下又迅速收回，语气强势霸道不耐烦，毫无素质可言。

对味儿了。

光头先是松了口气。

接着又重新打起十二分警惕。

一边赔笑一边意思，请进，敢问可是有什么案子需要我配合的？”

“赖德全、赖狗子是吧？上午市中心的枪杀案你应该知道吧？”许景川说话的同时随手拨开他走进了屋。

一边双手叉腰掀起西服衣摆环顾四周打量着客厅的陈设，一边随口轻飘飘的说道：“有人举报称看见凶手进了你家，配合一下我们的搜查。”

说完他头也不回的招了招手。

身后两名警员立刻拿出橡胶手套干净利落的戴上，迈步往二楼走去。

“警官你们……”

赖德全见状想追上去阻拦。

下一秒枪口就顶在了他头上。

赖德全的身体瞬间僵硬。

许景川持枪轻点他额头，表情似笑非笑，“心里有鬼啊？没鬼的话你怕什么？还是说有意阻拦办案？”

“这位警官，我跟白云街治安所的陈所长有一点交情……”赖德全脸一白，额头渗出了虚汗，强忍着憋屈和忐忑抬出自己的靠山想拉关系。

“啪！”

还不等他说完，许景川就用手枪握把尾部重重的砸在了他脸上。

“啊！”赖德全痛呼一声，脚步踉跄险些跌倒，捂着脸敢怒不敢言。

许景川啐了他一口。

“草！想用关系压我？管你认识什么阿猫阿狗，老子只知道这案子破不了我就得扒下身上这层皮！老老实实配合我们，就什么事都没有。”

“警官息怒，息怒，我配合就是了嘛。”赖德全尽管心里窝火，但是脸上却还得强行挤出笑容说好话。

在驻军不进城的情况下，警察就是唯一合法并且持枪的机关。

权力极大。

逼急了的话虽说真不至于一枪崩了他，但想折腾他也有的是手段。

许景川见状嗤笑一声收了枪。

接着走近沙发一屁股坐下。

又自然而然拿起桌上的烟抖出一根含着，同时双脚往桌子上一搭。

仿佛他才是此地的主人。

“早这样不就得了，我知道你是做什么的，这条街上的鸡鸭都是你养的嘛，兄弟我也不想跟你为难，但前提是你千万别让兄弟我感到为难。”

许景川语气漫不经心的警告。

第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Blue Star, New Era 29.

District 13.

Qingchuan City is dim at night.

Because power is available for a limited time.

Citizens can only use electricity for four hours every day from 10 am to 12 noon and from 5 pm to 7 pm.

Therefore, after seven o'clock in the evening, except for government agencies, wealthy areas with generators, and certain entertainment venues, most areas only have candles and oil lamps.

Technical workers of all colors were either scantily clad or naked, posing under the eaves in the dark to attract customers.

When the lights are not bright enough, a good figure is particularly commercially competitive.

Criss-crossing unplanned streets, low bungalows, simple shacks, garbage piled up everywhere, wild dogs rummaging for food...

The whole city is like one big slum.

No. 105, Baiyun Street, Xicheng District.

This is a two-story building.

The exterior walls are painted with white paint, and the orange light inside can be faintly seen through the iron-barred windows, which is incompatible with the surrounding low and simple residences with dim candlelight.

A dusty black car stopped in front of the small building, and three men got out of the car one after another.

The leader was in his early twenties, tall and muscular, with thick eyebrows and big eyes, and a handsome look. His black suit was open to reveal the white shirt underneath.

The other two, the fat one in his twenties and the thin one in his thirties, both wore black police uniforms. One was a police officer and the other was a mid-level police officer.

The fat man was holding a suitcase with the police badge of District 13 and "Qingchuan City Police Department" written on it.

The thin man took a deep breath and raised his hand to knock on the door.

"Dong dong dong!"

"Who is this late at night?" came an irritable, impatient and somewhat wary voice from inside the room.

"Police! Open the door!"

There was a brief silence in the room.

On the door after a while

A middle-aged man in a brown suit, of medium height, slightly fat, with a bald head and a mustache, looked out through the window.

After seeing the clothes of the three people clearly, the vigilance and irritability in his eyes receded a little.

"The three police officers look a little strange, don't they?"

The bald man said with a tentative smile.

"Fuck you! Do you know all the thousands of people in the Qingchuan Police Station? Stop wasting your fucking time by chirping. Either open the door or open the banquet!"

Xu Jingchuan, who was in a suit and leather tie, showed his police officer ID card through the window with a cold face and then quickly retracted it. His tone was strong, overbearing and impatient, without any quality at all.

Right.

The bald man breathed a sigh of relief at first.

Then he was on alert again.

He smiled apologetically and said, "Please come in. I would like to ask, but is there any case that requires my cooperation?""

"Lai Dequan, Lai Gouzi, right?You should know about the shooting in the city center this morning, right?"As Xu Jingchuan spoke, he pushed him away and walked into the house.

While lifting up the hem of his suit with his hands on his hips and looking around at the furnishings in the living room, he said casually: "Someone reported seeing the murderer entering your house, please cooperate with our search."

After speaking, he waved without looking back.

The two police officers behind him immediately took out their rubber gloves, put them on neatly, and walked towards the second floor.

"Officers, you..."

Upon seeing this, Ryder wanted to catch up and stop him.

The next second the gun was on his head.

Lai Dequan's body instantly stiffened.

Xu Jingchuan tapped his forehead with a gun, his expression half-smiling but not smiling, "Is there something going on in your heart?If there is no ghost, what are you afraid of?Or do you mean to obstruct the investigation of the case?"

"Officer, I have some friendship with Director Chen from the Baiyun Street Police Station..." Ryder's face turned pale, and sweat broke out on his forehead. He resisted the aggrievedness and anxiety and brought up his patron in an attempt to build a relationship.

"Crack!"

Before he could finish speaking, Xu Jingchuan hit him hard in the face with the butt of the pistol grip.

"Ah!"Ride Quan screamed in pain, staggered and almost fell down, covering his face but not daring to speak in anger.

Xu Jingchuan spat at him.

"Grass!Want to use your relationship to pressure me?No matter what cats or dogs you know, I only know that if this case cannot be solved, I have to peel off this layer of skin!If you cooperate with us honestly, nothing will happen."

“Officer, calm down, calm down, I’ll just cooperate."Although Lai Dequan was angry in his heart, he still had to force a smile on his face to say nice things.

When the garrison does not enter the city, the police are the only legal and armed agencies.

Great power.

Even if you're in a hurry, you won't be able to kill him with one shot, but you still have a lot of tricks to mess with him.

Seeing this, Xu Jingchuan sneered and put away his gun.

Then he walked over to the sofa and sat down.

Then he naturally picked up the cigarette on the table, shook it out and held it in his mouth, while putting his feet up on the table.

It's as if he is the master of this place.

"Isn't it enough? I know what you do. You raise the chickens and ducks on this street. Brother, I don't want to embarrass you, but the premise is that you must not make me feel embarrassed."

Xu Jingchuan warned in a nonchalant tone.
